name: Comic Book: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Comic Book look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, American comic book art, bold black ink outlines with heavy spot blacks, dynamic foreshortening, halftone dot shading, flat four-colour palette, strong complementary colours, dramatic single light source
negative_prompt: photorealistic, soft painterly shading, anime, 3d render, blurry, extra limbs, speech bubbles, watermark
